mars_news.title: Mars News
mars_news.purpose: A focused Mars bulletin: what happened, where, why it matters, and what comes next.
beats: Identify the station, setting, and the single lead story. State simulation status when applicable.
Develop the lead with location, cause, and consequences; distinguish observations from inference.
Explain the selected Mars location and background needed to understand this same story.
Give the next development to watch, uncertainties, and a clean sign-off. Do not restart the introduction.

star_news.title: Star News
star_news.purpose: One astronomy story explained clearly, with evidence, scale, uncertainty, and context from the solar map.
beats: Name the station and the astronomy topic; identify simulation or sourced mode.
Explain the central finding or fictional event without inventing current real-world news.
Explain the science and scale in ordinary language, using the same central story.
What we know and do not know
Separate evidence from interpretation; identify missing information.
Return to the headline, summarize the takeaway, and close without unrelated filler.

talk_hour.title: Talk Hour
talk_hour.purpose: A one-topic discussion with a clear question, connected chapters, a fair challenge, and a useful conclusion.
beats: Identify the station, host, simulation status, and the one question guiding this episode.
Give only the background needed to follow that question.
Develop a concrete view and example connected to the background.
Test the first view with a fair counterpoint. Respond to it rather than starting another topic.
Apply the discussion to the selected place or object. Clearly label any fictional scenario.
Answer the opening question, name remaining uncertainty, and close. Do not fabricate callers.

interview.title: Interviews
interview.purpose: An interview that introduces its guest, asks one question at a time, follows the answers, and closes the loop.
beats: Introduce the station, host, guest, and reason for the interview. Fictional guests must be labeled.
Ask how the guest came to this subject. In sourced mode, leave answers pending unless a supplied guest transcript supports them.
Ask for one specific example on the central topic. Follow the actual supplied answer or the explicitly fictional answer.
Build on the preceding answer, clarify uncertainty, and ask one fair challenging question.
Return to the opening purpose, invite a final takeaway, thank the guest, and sign off.
